english.title: Importer make available on UK market a prohibited category F2/F3 firework
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the importer of a

(A)_[category F2]_
(B)_[category F3]_

firework, being

(C)_[an aerial wheel,]_
(D)_[a banger, flash banger or double banger,]_
(E)_[a jumping cracker,]_
(F)_[a jumping ground spinner,]_
(G)_[a spinner,]_
(H)_[a mini rocket,]_
(I)_[a shot tube which produced a report as its principal effect,]_
(J)_[a shot tube, the inside diameter of which was greater than 30mm,]_
(K)_[a battery containing bangers, flash bangers or double bangers,]_
(L)_[a combination (other than a wheel) which included one or more bangers, flash bangers or double bangers,]_

and made it available on the market in the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 33(1), 62(2)(n) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an importer of a pyrotechnic article
made available on UK market
category F2/F3 firework of prohibited description

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence does not prohibit the making available on the market of a category F2 firework or category F3 firework as part of a wheel.
(ii) This offence does not prohibit the making available on the market of a category F2 firework or category F3 firework to a person with specialist knowledge.
